facts.text: I want to schedule a maintenance check for my road bike at a local bike shop.
I decided to upgrade my road bike's pedals to clipless pedals today.
I chose Shimano Ultegra clipless pedals for my road bike.
I have been noticing that my road bike brakes feel a bit spongy lately.
I am concerned about the cost of replacing the brake pads and cables.
I have already spent money on the new clipless pedals.
I plan to prioritize replacing the brake pads and cables for now.
I plan to consider upgrading to a more advanced brake system in the future.
I think I will leave the brake bleeding process to a professional mechanic for now.
I do not want to risk compromising my brake system's performance or safety.
